alpha_investigation.initial_suspicion: Raw transparent-image viewer showed colored striped halos.
alpha_investigation.resolution: False positive as a visible opaque-artifact claim. Actual RGBA compositing removes the colored halos, leaving subtle native shadows. Fully transparent RGB is not judged visible. All104 images separately checked on light and dark composites.
